# Included source notices

The main MIT license is retained at the project root. The imported process engine
and particle kernel come from the user's supplied RUPTURA C++ cycle and standalone
breakthrough packages. Their included license notices, where supplied, are kept
in this directory. New integration work is distributed with the main project.

`SCIPY_LICENSE.txt` accompanies the native BDF implementation's SciPy-derived
algorithm. The vendored `libyaml` distribution retains its own license; the
single-header `json.hpp` retains nlohmann JSON's license notice. SUNDIALS, Zig,
Python dependencies and system numerical libraries are build/runtime dependencies;
their binaries are not included in the source archive.
